_why: This is load-bearing, not bookkeeping. A monetised Reel is both an adaptation and a collection, so a single non-commercial asset anywhere in it can taint the whole video. Per-asset provenance with a DATED SCREENSHOT of the licence page is the only defence, because platform terms can change retroactively.
